questions.question: Which physical quantity has the dimensional formula [M L² T⁻²]?
questions.explanation: Work = Force × Displacement = [M L T⁻²] × [L] = [M L² T⁻²], which is also the dimension of Energy and Torque.

questions.question: For an ideal gas undergoing an isothermal reversible expansion, which of the following is true?
questions.explanation: Internal energy (U) of an ideal gas depends only on temperature. Since temperature is constant (ΔT = 0) in an isothermal process, ΔU = 0.

questions.question: If the radius of a current-carrying circular loop is doubled while keeping the current constant, the magnetic field at its center becomes:
questions.explanation: Magnetic field at the center of a circular loop is B = μ₀I / (2R). Since B is inversely proportional to R, doubling R halves B.

questions.question: Which among the following molecules has zero dipole moment (μ = 0) due to symmetrical geometry?
questions.explanation: BF₃ has a symmetrical trigonal planar geometry (sp² hybridization) where the three B–F bond dipoles cancel out completely, resulting in μ = 0.

questions.question: The escape velocity from the surface of the Earth (radius R, acceleration due to gravity g) is given by:
questions.explanation: Equating kinetic energy (½mv²) to gravitational potential energy (GMm/R = mgR) gives v_e = √(2gR) ≈ 11.2 km/s.
